verdict.rationale: The only first-party programmatic surface in the evidence is the Thoropass MCP server. It covers a narrow slice of the UI: listing audits and evidence requests, and adding comments, attachments and status updates to evidence requests, within admin-set permission limits. Nothing shows programmatic access to the rest of the UI, such as controls, Risk Register, policies, monitors, access reviews or user management, so parity with the UI is far from demonstrated. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API, API coverage of controls, risks, policies, monitors, access reviews and admin functions, any stated API–UI parity commitment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: List audits and view audit details ... List evidence requests, view their details, and see the systems tied to them
